translations.web: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
translations.bsb: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
translations.kjv: Let ➔ no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
translations.asv: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an ensample to them that believe, in word, in manner of life, in love, in faith, in purity.
